effects.name: Tidal
effects.tooltip: Tidal : This weapon is sheathed in water. A tidal weapon deals an extra 1 to 4 points of damage on a successful hit. Creatures with the Fire trait take double this damage instead.

effects.name: Gust of Wind
effects.tooltip: Gust of Wind Caster level: 3 Charges: 3 (0/day)

flavor_text: This staff, made from weathered driftwood, is adorned with small shells and smells of the sea air. It has the power to summon a strong and sudden gust of wind, likely used to fill the sails of a ship. This power recharges automatically as time passes.
tips: The charges on this item recharge over time, not with rest. The Pirate Treasure Map , the 3 items from the Corsair's Cunning set, the 4 'Scoundrel's type' weapons and Brine Shaman's Staff have a chance of appearing in the end reward list of any of the Three-Barrel Cove (heroic) quests, except Guard Duty . Every third completion you will receive a complete list.
